mapper.sql: m.id, m.model_code, m.model_name, m.client_id, c.client_code, c.client_name, COALESCE(c.client_type, m.client_type) AS client_type, COALESCE(c.base_url, m.base_url) AS base_url, m.api_model, m.enabled, CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key) IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key) = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key)) <= 2 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key), 1, 1), '***', SUBSTRING(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key), CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key)), 1)) WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key)) <= 8 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key), 1, 2), '****', SUBSTRING(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key), CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key)), 1)) ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key), 1, 4), '****', SUBSTRING(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key), CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(c.api_key, m.api_key)) - 3, 4)) END AS api_key_masked, m.ext_json, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.created_by, m.updated_by AS last_modified_by, m.version
FROM ai_model_config m LEFT JOIN ai_client_config c ON c.id = m.client_id

if.if: AND ( m.model_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.model_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.api_model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(c.base_url, m.base_url) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.client_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.client_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.ext_json LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.ext_json, '$.priority')) AS SIGNED), 100) ASC, m.update_time DESC, m.id DESC
